_note: Lead/runner VISUAL review — I rendered each PNG and actually looked at it (image-legibility QA hook, AGENTS Plot and Human-Review Gate). 'pass' is set only after that read. Auto checks (existence/size) are merged in by make_figs.py; file existence alone is NOT verification.
_review_criteria: readable font sizes; no clipped labels; no overlapping text; no plain underscore/caret strings masquerading as rendered math; every figure states its run/dataset; invalidity (non-convergence) flagged ON the figure.
_iterations: 3 rounds. Round 1 REJECTED both: fig i had the MAP/R-hat annotations colliding with the x tick labels and a caption clipped at the right edge; fig ii had the track labels overlapping the y=x note and the S2 box. Round 2 REJECTED: caption still clipped (unwrapped lines), arm C's MAP label rendered white-on-white outside its short 200-500 bar, dead canvas. Round 3 accepted after wrapping captions, adaptive MAP-label placement (inside tall bars in white, above short bars in brown), moving the colour key into empty canvas, and retuning leader-line offsets.

fig_arms_bands_corrected.png.visual_review: PASS (round 3). Checked: all 12 bars start at zero on a shared linear P1' axis (lie factor ~1, no truncated baseline); value labels sit above each whisker with no collisions; the two MAP-derived bars (B, C) carry 'MAP / R-hat 360.6 / ESS 2.0' in BOTH panels — white inside the tall bars, brown above the short 200-500 C bar (0.031) where white-on-white would have been invisible; no F=R row (F's identity is stated in the caption instead of a duplicate C bar); caption fully visible, wrapped, states quantity/units/data count/provenance and the leak-vs-basis-mismatch decomposition; run stamp present. NIT (accepted, not blocking): the white 'R-hat 360.6' line nearly spans the full bar width at 6.6pt — legible, but it would break if the bar got narrower.

fig_screening_vs_exact.png.visual_review: PASS (round 3). Checked: all 28 points visible, tracks distinguished by colour AND separated in the key placed in empty lower-left canvas (no legend box over data); equal aspect with a y=x reference line labelled in place, so 'below the line = screening flattered it' reads directly off the geometry; the three S2-selected candidates are circled with leader lines to labels in empty canvas — no label covers a point or another label; the S2 box sits in the empty lower-right triangle and states BOTH selection conventions, both SEs, both rule outcomes, and both Spearmans; caption wrapped and fully visible, carries the D16 scope limitation (agent proposed zero model-form edits) so the figure cannot be over-read. Identifiers like theta_MAP / wa2_tbox_xbeam are file/candidate names, not equations, so the no-underscore-math rule does not apply.
